meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 agent-browser 命令操控浏览器:打开网址、点击和填写页面元素、截图或存成 PDF、录屏,并读取页面的文字、标题、链接等信息。
howto.when: 当你需要打开网站、与网页交互或截图等浏览器操作,或做网页测试、提取页面信息时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,整页截图保存到 page.png
把表单里的邮箱填成 user@test.com,再点提交
say.note: 先快照元素,再填写和点击

say.text: 对比这两个网址的页面差异
say.note: 用 diff url 比较两个地址

howto.what_en: Claude drives a browser through agent-browser commands: open URLs, click and fill page elements, take screenshots or save PDFs, record video, and read page text, titles and links.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to open websites, interact with pages, take screenshots, or test web apps and extract page information.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a full-page screenshot to page.png
say_en.note: Opens the page and screenshots it

say_en.text: Fill the form's email with user@test.com and click Submit
say_en.note: Snapshots elements, then fills and clicks

say_en.text: Compare these two URLs and show the page differences
say_en.note: Runs diff url on both addresses
